title.zh: 微软：朝鲜黑客用AI批量生成钓鱼文档，假招聘与恶意代码开发已落地
title.en: 微软：朝鲜黑客用AI批量生成钓鱼文档，假招聘与恶意代码开发已落地

current_state.zh: Microsoft threat intelligence reports that North Korean hacking groups have moved AI into daily attack workflows — mass-generating tailored phishing documents, running fake job campaigns against AI and blockchain professionals, and using tools like Cursor and the ARTEX framework for malware development and detection evasion.
